title: Increase starting balance and show full car designs in Shop and on-track visualization

requirements.text: Set the default starting user balance to 1000000000000000 (Nat) for newly created user profiles.

quotes: make the people start with 1000000000000000 money

acceptanceCriteria: When a brand-new user creates/saves their profile for the first time, their stored UserProfile.balance is 1000000000000000.
Existing users’ balances are not modified by this change.
The Shop balance display reflects the new starting balance for new users after profile creation (no manual refresh required beyond existing React Query invalidation/loads).

requirements.text: Update the Shop page to support browsing and selecting full car designs (model/body style) with a visual preview, not just selecting colors.

quotes: make the car designs in the shop not only the colors

acceptanceCriteria: Each car model/design in the shop has a clear visual preview of the design (e.g., using the existing 3D car viewer component) that updates when the user changes the selected variant (color) for that design.
Users can still purchase a specific variant (design + color) as they do today.
Owned variants remain clearly indicated and cannot be re-purchased (current behavior preserved).

requirements.text: Update the on-track visualization during gameplay so the player’s displayed car matches the currently selected/active car design (model name) and color, instead of a generic car icon.

quotes: and on thhe track the car is being displayed

acceptanceCriteria: On the Race page, the moving player marker in the track visualization reflects the active car’s color and design (derived from the active car’s catalog entry).
If no active car is selected, the track visualization uses the existing fallback car ("Default Racer", blue) consistently with the existing 3D viewer fallback.
No Internet Identity login state regressions: the Race page still works in practice/demo and logged-out scenarios as it does now.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional canisters/services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose them instead).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new backend databases or external storage.
Introducing new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Implementing real-time multiplayer/ghost racing backends or WebSocket features.
Creating entirely new car asset pipelines/models beyond using the existing in-app 3D car rendering approach.
